fusions.name: Breach the Guard
fusions.desc: Drives a tine through the target's guard, dealing 13 damage, leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds and stunning it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Burst Spokes
fusions.desc: Looses 3 tines at once, spread apart, each dealing 24 damage and bursting on impact to hit everything within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that.

fusions.name: Anchored Plate
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 24 damage and holds for 8 seconds, and your armour rises by 8%.

fusions.name: Blackened Temper
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 5% sooner. Your armour rises by 10%.
